title: On the Universality of Simple Trust-Region Algorithms
summary: We establish universal complexity guarantees for quadratic trust-region methods and identify a common mechanism underlying their universal behavior under convexity, based on a function-gap model-decrease estimate that appears to be new in the trust-region literature. First, we prove that the basic trust-region method with inexact subproblem solves is universal under convexity.
